description.en: Evidence-informed stylized whole-organism Palaeocoma, informed by P. milleri MSNVI044/017(b). Five robust arms and a central disc preserve the reviewed gross form; nominal dimensions, concealed surfaces, fine details, colour and pose are artistic rather than a literal specimen copy.
description.zh: 参考 P. milleri MSNVI044/017(b) 的全体风格化复原，保留中央盘与五条粗腕的已审总体形态；名义尺寸、隐藏表面、细节、颜色和姿态为创作，不是标本逐点复制。
